annotations.text:
CHOSEN — the build target.

The page you have, plus three things:

1. A STICKY context bar — "Showing 24 of 247" with sort and filter. It must not scroll away; it is what stops a long feed feeling bottomless.
2. An EXPLICIT "Load 24 more", naming what is left. Not silent infinite scroll: a guest should always know how much board is behind them.
3. Filters keep searching ALL 247, never just what is on screen.

THE HARD PART IS NOT THE FRONTEND. Today `/api/v1/item-requests/public` returns every approved request as one array and the board filters it client-side — and the per-category counts exist BECAUSE of that. Page the request naively and every number on this screen starts lying.

So this needs the endpoint to return a page AND the aggregate totals in the same response. That is the same ceiling already noted for the homepage's live-needs grid: one backend change serves both.

NOT CHOSEN — kept for reference, not being built.

Worth stealing from later: Groups' warning badges ("6 urgent", "4 over 30d") are a better summary than a bare count, and City+pages' addressable pages matter if this board should ever rank in search or be linked to.
